local_checks.invariant: View-mode selection uses only the markdown, changed, and deleted flags plus the changed-file preference. A stored path is not an input to that decision.
local_checks.result: FileDescriptor has is_markdown, is_changed, and is_deleted, and no path field. default_mode returns Diff when the file is changed and either deleted or the preference is Diff, and otherwise uses the markdown content mode. applicable_modes starts with that default, adds diff modes only when changed, adds RenderedMarkdown only when markdown, and always ends with SyntaxContent. Controller::descriptor derives the three flags from the extension, a root-relative status lookup, and path.exists() for a git-deleted path. The policy functions never receive a path.

local_checks.invariant: Choosing a mode does not authorize a path. Content reads and diffs keep their existing root checks on the tree path.
local_checks.result: effective_mode uses an operator override or default_mode. LiveContent::render_at_width calls render::classify for non-diff modes, and classify canonicalizes and refuses paths outside the root. Diff and FullDiff render git text, and git::diff returns empty unless is_within_root accepts the relative path. Neither check reads FileDescriptor.

hardening: Root-picker drawing slices the prompt at the caret. The slice stays valid because the cursor is private and every mutator preserves a boundary, and the text is the operator's own keystrokes.

descriptor uses path.exists(), which follows symlinks, only to clear the deleted flag when a git-deleted path is present. A content-mode choice for that path still goes through render::classify before file bytes are shown.
